replaces.idea: A brass out-of-band intercom box on stubby feet with a perforated speaker grille, a toggle switch, and a glowing amber lamp.
A hand-crank brass starter box on a base with two jumper-clamp electrodes on top for restarting stalled servers.
A countertop brass ticket-dispenser on feet spitting out a short paper slip from a front slot.
A brass three-way pipe manifold on a floor flange with a round pressure gauge and two braided hoses.

new.name: Out-of-Band Intercom
new.concept: Intel AMT (Active Management Technology) remote out-of-band management
new.depicts: A small brass intercom box standing on four stubby feet, with a perforated speaker grille, a side toggle switch, and a single amber indicator lamp on top.
new.focal: The glowing amber indicator lamp above the speaker grille

new.name: Reincarnation Crank
new.concept: MINIX 3 Reincarnation Server (rs) restarting crashed user-space drivers
new.depicts: A heavy ochre-and-brass magneto starter box on a flat base, with a side hand-crank and two upright jumper-clamp electrodes on top.

new.name: Port 16992 Dispenser
new.concept: Embedded HTTP web server (httpd) serving ME management pages
new.depicts: A compact brass countertop ticket-dispenser on four short feet, with a front slot ejecting a short cream paper slip.
new.focal: The cream paper slip emerging from the front slot

new.name: Packet Manifold
new.concept: User-space TCP/IP network stack (inet) inside the Management Engine
new.depicts: A three-way brass pipe manifold bolted to a floor flange, topped with a round pressure gauge and flanked by two curved braided hoses.
new.focal: The round pressure gauge mounted at the center junction

new.name: Process Timeclock
new.concept: MINIX 3 Process Manager (pm) handling fork, exec, and exit
new.depicts: A tall narrow brass punch-card timeclock on a pedestal base, with a top card slot and a small side lever.
new.focal: The top card slot with a protruding punch card

new.name: VFS Rotary Index
new.depicts: A small brass rotary card index on an A-frame stand, with a side knob and fanned-out tabbed index cards.
new.focal: The fanned-out tabbed index cards on the drum

new.name: Pneumatic Dispatch
new.concept: MINIX 3 synchronous message-passing IPC between user-space servers
new.depicts: A vertical brass pneumatic-tube station on a floor stand, with a hinged hatch and a cylindrical message capsule resting inside.
new.focal: The cylindrical message capsule visible in the open hatch

new.name: Escapement Watchdog
new.concept: User-space watchdog timer keeping the ME subsystem responsive
new.depicts: A small exposed-gear brass escapement clockwork mounted on a weighted pedestal base.
new.focal: The toothed brass balance wheel at the center
